content: As an upper bound for model performance, we assess how well humans can solve our task. Two trained annotators labeled the correct answer on all instances of the test set. They agreed with the gold standard in 98.2 % of cases. This result shows that humans have no difficulty in finding the correct answer, irrespective of the question type.
